draft.subject: Re: API pagination and your open questions
draft.body:
Hi Lin,

Thanks for the questions, and good to talk on Monday. On the API: list endpoints use cursor-based pagination, so you won't need to pull everything in one call.

On timing, a cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing cycle, not immediately. I've kept both tickets open so nothing gets lost, and a colleague will follow up on the billing side directly.

If it's useful, I'm happy to hop on a 20-minute call this week to walk through getting your team's real work into Wrenfield before you decide.

Best,
Priya
